  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function computeFitPenalty(pRole, pSecStr, targetSlot) {
    if (pRole === targetSlot) return 0.00;
    const secList = (pSecStr && pSecStr !== "None")
      ? pSecStr.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      : [];
    if (secList.includes(targetSlot)) return 0.05;

    const isCb = r => r === "Left Center Back" || r === "Right Center Back" || r === "Center Back";
    const isFb = r => r === "Left Back" || r === "Right Back";
    const isW  = r => r === "Left Winger" || r === "Right Winger";

    if (isCb(pRole) && isCb(targetSlot)) return 0.10;
    if (isFb(pRole) && isW(targetSlot)) return 0.20;
    if (isW(pRole) && (isFb(targetSlot) || targetSlot === "Center Forward")) return 0.15;
    if (pRole === "Center Forward" && isW(targetSlot)) return 0.15;
    if (pRole === "Central Midfielder" && (targetSlot === "Defensive Midfielder" || targetSlot === "Attacking Midfielder")) return 0.10;
    if (pRole === "Defensive Midfielder" && targetSlot === "Central Midfielder") return 0.10;
    if (pRole === "Attacking Midfielder" && (targetSlot === "Central Midfielder" || isW(targetSlot))) return 0.15;
    if (pRole === "Goalkeeper" && targetSlot !== "Goalkeeper") return 999.0;
    if (pRole !== "Goalkeeper" && targetSlot === "Goalkeeper") return 999.0;
    return 1.00;
  }

  // Exact O(M^2 * N) Hungarian / Jonker-Volgenant min-cost rectangular matching (rows M <= cols N)
  // Returns matchCol[row] (0-indexed) for each row in 0..M-1.
  function solveHungarianMinCost(costMatrix) {
    const M = costMatrix.length;
    if (M === 0) return [];
    const N = costMatrix[0].length;
    if (N < M) throw new Error("Hungarian requires cols >= rows.");

    const u   = new Float64Array(M + 1);
    const v   = new Float64Array(N + 1);
    const p   = new Int32Array(N + 1);
    const way = new Int32Array(N + 1);

    for (let i = 1; i <= M; i++) {
      p[0] = i;
      let j0 = 0;
      const minv = new Float64Array(N + 1).fill(Infinity);
      const used = new Uint8Array(N + 1);

      do {
        used[j0] = 1;
        const i0 = p[j0];
        let delta = Infinity;
        let j1 = 0;
        const rowI0 = costMatrix[i0 - 1];
        for (let j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
          if (!used[j]) {
            const cur = rowI0[j - 1] - u[i0] - v[j];
            if (cur < minv[j]) {
              minv[j] = cur;
              way[j] = j0;
            }
            if (minv[j] < delta) {
              delta = minv[j];
              j1 = j;
            }
          }
        }
        for (let j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
          if (used[j]) {
            u[p[j]] += delta;
            v[j] -= delta;
          } else {
            minv[j] -= delta;
          }
        }
        j0 = j1;
      } while (p[j0] !== 0);

      do {
        const j1 = way[j0];
        p[j0] = p[j1];
        j0 = j1;
      } while (j0);
    }

    const rowToCol = new Array(M);
    for (let j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
      if (p[j] > 0) rowToCol[p[j] - 1] = j - 1;
    }
    return rowToCol;
  }

  function solveBestXI(squadPlayers, allLeaguePlayers, formation, metric, formationTemplates) {
    const slots = (formationTemplates && formationTemplates[formation])
      ? formationTemplates[formation]
      : FALLBACK_MANIFEST.formations[formation];
    if (!slots || squadPlayers.length < 11) return null;

    let cohort = allLeaguePlayers.filter(p => p.active && p.role !== "Goalkeeper");
    if (cohort.length < 11) {
      cohort = allLeaguePlayers.filter(p => p.mins >= 450 && p.role !== "Goalkeeper");
    }
    let replacementPrior = quantileType7(cohort.map(p => p[metric]), 0.20);
    if (!Number.isFinite(replacementPrior)) replacementPrior = 0.0;

    const nPlayers = squadPlayers.length;
    const M = slots.length; // 11

    // Build reward[slot][player] and find maxReward to shift into non-negative min-cost
    const rewardMatrix = Array.from({ length: M }, () => new Float64Array(nPlayers));
    let maxReward = -Infinity;

    for (let i = 0; i < nPlayers; i++) {
      const p = squadPlayers[i];
      let pScore;
      if (p.role === "Goalkeeper") {
        pScore = p.ss;
      } else {
        const bw = p.mins / (p.mins + 450.0);
        pScore = bw * p[metric] + (1.0 - bw) * replacementPrior;
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < M; j++) {
        const pen = computeFitPenalty(p.role, p.sec_role, slots[j]);
        const r = pScore - pen;
        rewardMatrix[j][i] = r;
        if (r > maxReward) maxReward = r;
      }
    }

    const costMatrix = Array.from({ length: M }, (_, j) => {
      const row = new Float64Array(nPlayers);
      for (let i = 0; i < nPlayers; i++) row[i] = maxReward - rewardMatrix[j][i];
      return row;
    });

    const assignedPlayerIdx = solveHungarianMinCost(costMatrix);
    const chosenSet = new Set(assignedPlayerIdx);
    let totalObjective = 0;

    const lineup = assignedPlayerIdx.map((pIdx, j) => {
      totalObjective += rewardMatrix[j][pIdx];
      return { slot: slots[j], player: squadPlayers[pIdx] };
    });

    const bench = squadPlayers
      .filter((_, idx) => !chosenSet.has(idx))
      .sort((a, b) => b.net - a.net);

    return { lineup, bench, objective: totalObjective, replacementPrior, slots };
  }

  // Expose pure computational engine for headless Node parity verification
  const TEST_API = {
    FALLBACK_MANIFEST,
    normSearch,
    slugifyPlayerName,
    formatSigned,
    formatActivityDate,
    getOrdinalSuffix,
    classifyCohort,
    ecdfPercentile,
    quantileType7,
    unpackColumns,
    hydrateLeagueData,
    parseWtpsBinary,
    evaluateTpsMesh,
    buildColorPalette,
    extractClosedSuperlevelRings,
    extractOpenAndClosedIsolines,
    chaikinSmooth,
    computeTanakaStyle,
    resolveActiveWarMetric,
    filterAndSortWarRows,
    formatWarKpiLeader,
    generateWarCsv,
    computeFitPenalty,
    solveHungarianMinCost,
    solveBestXI,
    renderFullImpactCanvas,
    renderHalfPitchCanvas
  };
  if (typeof globalThis !== "undefined") {
    globalThis.__RAPM_TEST_API__ = TEST_API;
  }

  // Exit early when loaded outside a browser DOM (e.g., headless Node unit suite)
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.getElementById("global_league_select")) {
    return;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 7. BROWSER RUNTIME CONTROLLER & INTERACTIVE UI WIRING
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const STATE = {
    manifest: FALLBACK_MANIFEST,
    palette19: buildColorPalette(FALLBACK_MANIFEST.mccurdy_palette, 19),
    tps: null,
    activeLeagueId: "nwsl",
    leagueCache: new Map(), // leagueId -> hydrated league object
    activeTab: "profile",
    fontsReadyPromise: null,
    playerCombo: null,
    // Tab 2 state
    warSortCol: null,
    warSortDir: "desc",
    warPage: 1,
    warFilteredCache: [],
    // Tab 3 state
    benchPage: 1,
    lastBestXi: null
  };

  function ensureFontsPromise() {
    if (!STATE.fontsReadyPromise) {
      const waitFonts = (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready)
        ? Promise.all([
            document.fonts.load("700 48px Assistant").catch(() => {}),
            document.fonts.load("400 26px Assistant").catch(() => {}),
            document.fonts.ready
          ])
        : Promise.resolve();
      const timeout = new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 1200));
      STATE.fontsReadyPromise = Promise.race([waitFonts, timeout]);
    }
    return STATE.fontsReadyPromise;
  }

  function setStatus(kind, msg) {
    const dot = document.getElementById("rapm_status_dot");
    const txt = document.getElementById("rapm_status_text");
    if (dot) dot.className = "rapm-status-dot" + (kind === "ready" ? "" : " " + kind);
    if (txt) txt.textContent = msg;
  }

  function showError(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById("rapm_error_banner");
    if (!el) return;
    if (msg) {
      el.textContent = msg;
      el.classList.add("visible");
    } else {
      el.textContent = "";
      el.classList.remove("visible");
    }
  }

  function getActiveLeague() {
    return STATE.leagueCache.get(STATE.activeLeagueId) || null;
  }

  function getActiveLeagueMeta() {
    return (STATE.manifest.leagues || []).find(l => l.id === STATE.activeLeagueId) || null;
  }

  // Custom searchable combobox matching goalkeepers.qmd UX
  function initPlayerCombobox(onChange) {
    const hiddenEl = document.getElementById("prof_player_select");
    const inputEl  = document.getElementById("prof_player_select_search");
    const menuEl   = document.getElementById("prof_player_select_menu");
    const wrapEl   = document.getElementById("wrap_prof_player_select");

    const comboState = {
      items: [],
      filtered: [],
      selectedId: "",
      selectedLabel: "",
      highlightIdx: 0
    };

    function ensureOptionVisible(node) {
      if (!node) return;
      const top = node.offsetTop;
      const bottom = top + node.offsetHeight;
      if (top < menuEl.scrollTop) {
        menuEl.scrollTop = top;
      } else if (bottom > menuEl.scrollTop + menuEl.clientHeight) {
        menuEl.scrollTop = bottom - menuEl.clientHeight;
      }
    }

    function renderMenu(query) {
      const q = normSearch(query).trim();
      comboState.filtered = q
        ? comboState.items.filter(p => p._norm.includes(q) || normSearch(p.team).includes(q))
        : comboState.items;

      menuEl.innerHTML = "";
      if (comboState.filtered.length === 0) {
        const emp = document.createElement("div");
        emp.className = "rapm-search-empty";
        emp.textContent = "No matching players";
        menuEl.appendChild(emp);
        return;
      }

      comboState.highlightIdx = Math.max(0, comboState.filtered.findIndex(p => p.id === comboState.selectedId));

      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < comboState.filtered.length; i++) {
        const p = comboState.filtered[i];
        const row = document.createElement("div");
        row.className = "rapm-search-option" + (i === comboState.highlightIdx ? " active" : "");
        row.dataset.idx = String(i);
        const mainSpan = document.createElement("span");
        mainSpan.textContent = p.name;
        const subSpan = document.createElement("span");
        subSpan.className = "rapm-search-option-sub";
        subSpan.textContent = p.team;
        row.appendChild(mainSpan);
        row.appendChild(subSpan);
        frag.appendChild(row);
      }
      menuEl.appendChild(frag);

      ensureOptionVisible(menuEl.children[comboState.highlightIdx]);
    }

    menuEl.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
      const opt = e.target.closest(".rapm-search-option");
      if (!opt) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const idx = Number(opt.dataset.idx);
      const picked = comboState.filtered[idx];
      if (picked) {
        selectPlayer(picked.id, picked.name, true);
        closeMenu();
      }
    });

    function selectPlayer(id, name, trigger) {
      comboState.selectedId = String(id || "");
      comboState.selectedLabel = String(name || "");
      hiddenEl.value = comboState.selectedId;
      inputEl.value = comboState.selectedLabel;
      if (trigger && onChange) onChange();
    }

    function openMenu() {
      inputEl.value = "";
      menuEl.classList.add("open");
      renderMenu("");
    }

    function closeMenu() {
      menuEl.classList.remove("open");
      inputEl.value = comboState.selectedLabel;
    }

    inputEl.addEventListener("focus", openMenu);
    inputEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) openMenu();
    });
    inputEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) menuEl.classList.add("open");
      renderMenu(inputEl.value);
    });
    inputEl.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) return;
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (comboState.filtered.length > 0 && menuEl.children.length > 0) {
          comboState.highlightIdx = Math.min(comboState.highlightIdx + 1, menuEl.children.length - 1);
          Array.from(menuEl.children).forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle("active", i === comboState.highlightIdx));
          ensureOptionVisible(menuEl.children[comboState.highlightIdx]);
        }
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (comboState.filtered.length > 0 && menuEl.children.length > 0) {
          comboState.highlightIdx = Math.max(comboState.highlightIdx - 1, 0);
          Array.from(menuEl.children).forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle("active", i === comboState.highlightIdx));
          ensureOptionVisible(menuEl.children[comboState.highlightIdx]);
        }
      } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        const picked = comboState.filtered[comboState.highlightIdx];
        if (picked) {
          selectPlayer(picked.id, picked.name, true);
          closeMenu();
          inputEl.blur();
        }
      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
        closeMenu();
        inputEl.blur();
      }
    });

    wrapEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    document.addEventListener("click", closeMenu);

    return {
      setPlayers(list) {
        comboState.items = list;
        const kept = list.find(p => p.id === comboState.selectedId);
        if (kept) {
          selectPlayer(kept.id, kept.name, false);
        } else if (list.length > 0) {
          selectPlayer(list[0].id, list[0].name, false);
        } else {
          selectPlayer("", "", false);
        }
      },
      getSelectedId() {
        return comboState.selectedId;
      }
    };
  }

  // --- TAB 1 RENDERING ---
  function renderProfileMetadata(player, meta) {
    const el = document.getElementById("prof_player_metadata_ui");
    if (!player) {
      el.innerHTML = `<p style="color:#777777; font-style:italic;">No outfield player selected.</p>`;
      return;
    }

    const pDt = formatActivityDate(player.last_played, "full", "Did Not Play this season");
    const rDt = formatActivityDate(player.last_rostered, "full", "N/A");
    const hasWar = Boolean(meta && meta.has_war) && player.war !== null;
    const hasExact = Boolean(meta && meta.has_war_exact) && player.war_exact !== null;
    const p30Text = player.war_p30 !== null ? player.war_p30.toFixed(2) : "N/A (< 450 mins)";
    const p30ExactText = player.war_p30_exact !== null ? player.war_p30_exact.toFixed(2) : "N/A (< 450 mins)";

    let html = `
      <h5>${escapeHtml(player.name)}</h5>
      <p><strong>Role: </strong>${escapeHtml(player.role)}</p>
      <p><strong>Team: </strong>${escapeHtml(player.team)}</p>
      <p><strong>Last Played: </strong>${escapeHtml(pDt)}</p>
      <p><strong>Last Rostered: </strong>${escapeHtml(rDt)}</p>
      <p><strong>Total Minutes: </strong>${Math.round(player.mins).toLocaleString("en-US")}</p>
      <p><strong>Net RAPM / 90: </strong>${formatSigned(player.net, 3)}</p>
      <p><strong>Offensive Impact / 90: </strong>${formatSigned(player.off, 3)}</p>
      <p><strong>Defensive Impact / 90: </strong>${formatSigned(player.def, 3)}</p>
    `;

    if (hasWar) {
      html += `
        <hr class="rapm-divider">
        <p><strong>Wins Above Replacement (WAR): </strong>${player.war.toFixed(2)}</p>
        ${hasExact ? `<p><strong>WAR (Exact DC): </strong>${player.war_exact.toFixed(2)}</p>` : ""}
        <p><strong>WAR (per 30 Matches): </strong>${p30Text}</p>
        ${hasExact ? `<p><strong>WAR/30 (Exact DC): </strong>${p30ExactText}</p>` : ""}
        <p><strong>Goals Above Replacement (GAR): </strong>${formatSigned(player.gar, 2)}</p>
        <p><strong>Goals Above Average (GAA): </strong>${formatSigned(player.gaa, 2)}</p>
        <p><strong>Points Above Replacement (PAR): </strong>${formatSigned(player.par, 1)}</p>
      `;
    }

    el.innerHTML = html;
  }

  async function renderTab1() {
    const league = getActiveLeague();
    if (!league) return;
    const playerId = STATE.playerCombo ? STATE.playerCombo.getSelectedId() : "";
    const player = league.playersById.get(playerId) || null;
    renderProfileMetadata(player, league.meta);

    const viewMode = (document.querySelector('input[name="prof_view_mode"]:checked') || {}).value || "full";
    document.getElementById("prof_view_full").style.display         = viewMode === "full" ? "block" : "none";
    document.getElementById("prof_view_offense").style.display      = viewMode === "offense" ? "block" : "none";
    document.getElementById("prof_view_defense").style.display      = viewMode === "defense" ? "block" : "none";
    document.getElementById("prof_view_side_by_side").style.display = viewMode === "side_by_side" ? "block" : "none";

    if (!player || !STATE.tps) return;
    await ensureFontsPromise();

    const lgMeta = getActiveLeagueMeta();
    if (viewMode === "full") {
      renderFullImpactCanvas(document.getElementById("canvas_full"), STATE.tps, league, lgMeta, player, STATE.palette19);
    } else if (viewMode === "offense") {
      renderHalfPitchCanvas(document.getElementById("canvas_offense"), STATE.tps, league, lgMeta, player, STATE.palette19, "offense");
    } else if (viewMode === "defense") {
      renderHalfPitchCanvas(document.getElementById("canvas_defense"), STATE.tps, league, lgMeta, player, STATE.palette19, "defense");
    } else {
      renderHalfPitchCanvas(document.getElementById("canvas_dual_offense"), STATE.tps, league, lgMeta, player, STATE.palette19, "offense");
      renderHalfPitchCanvas(document.getElementById("canvas_dual_defense"), STATE.tps, league, lgMeta, player, STATE.palette19, "defense");
    }
  }

  async function downloadPngMap(kind) {
    const league = getActiveLeague();
    if (!league || !STATE.tps) return;
    const playerId = STATE.playerCombo ? STATE.playerCombo.getSelectedId() : "";
    const player = league.playersById.get(playerId);
    if (!player) return;

    await ensureFontsPromise();
    const lgMeta = getActiveLeagueMeta();
    const offscreen = document.createElement("canvas");

    let filenameSuffix;
    if (kind === "full") {
      renderFullImpactCanvas(offscreen, STATE.tps, league, lgMeta, player, STATE.palette19);
      filenameSuffix = "_full_impact.png";
    } else if (kind === "offense") {
      renderHalfPitchCanvas(offscreen, STATE.tps, league, lgMeta, player, STATE.palette19, "offense");
      filenameSuffix = "_isolated_offense.png";
    } else {
      renderHalfPitchCanvas(offscreen, STATE.tps, league, lgMeta, player, STATE.palette19, "defense");
      filenameSuffix = "_isolated_defense.png";
    }

    const fname = (slugifyPlayerName(player.name) || "player") + filenameSuffix;
    offscreen.toBlob((blob) => {
      if (!blob) return;
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = fname;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);
    }, "image/png");
  }

  // --- TAB 2 RENDERING ---
  function renderTab2() {
    const league = getActiveLeague();
    if (!league) return;

    const hasExact = Boolean(league.meta && league.meta.has_war_exact);
    document.getElementById("war_opt_exact_wrap").style.display     = hasExact ? "flex" : "none";
    document.getElementById("war_opt_p30_exact_wrap").style.display = hasExact ? "flex" : "none";

    const rawMetric = (document.querySelector('input[name="war_plot_metric"]:checked') || {}).value || "war";
    const metric = resolveActiveWarMetric(league.meta, rawMetric);
    if (metric !== rawMetric) {
      const targetRadio = document.querySelector(`input[name="war_plot_metric"][value="${metric}"]`);
      if (targetRadio) targetRadio.checked = true;
    }

    const posFilter   = document.getElementById("war_pos_filter").value;
    const teamFilter  = document.getElementById("war_team_filter").value;
    const minMins     = Number(document.getElementById("war_min_minutes").value) || 0;
    const searchQuery = document.getElementById("war_table_search").value || "";

    document.getElementById("war_min_minutes_val").textContent = `${minMins} mins`;

    const { ranked, displayed } = filterAndSortWarRows(league.warRows, {
      posFilter, teamFilter, minMins, metric, searchQuery,
      sortCol: STATE.warSortCol, sortDir: STATE.warSortDir
    });
    STATE.warFilteredCache = displayed;

    // KPI Cards
    const leaderLabelMap = {
      war: "Leader (Most WAR)",
      war_p30: "Leader (WAR / 30)",
      war_exact: "Leader (Exact DC WAR)",
      war_p30_exact: "Leader (Exact WAR/30)"
    };
    document.getElementById("war_kpi_leader_sub").textContent = leaderLabelMap[metric] || "Leader";
    document.getElementById("war_kpi_total_players").textContent = ranked.length.toLocaleString("en-US");
    document.getElementById("war_kpi_top_player").textContent    = formatWarKpiLeader(ranked, metric);
    document.getElementById("war_kpi_top_outfield").textContent  = formatWarKpiLeader(ranked.filter(r => r.pos !== "GK"), metric);
    document.getElementById("war_kpi_top_gk").textContent        = formatWarKpiLeader(ranked.filter(r => r.pos === "GK"), metric);

    // Plotly Scatter Plot
    const plotEl = document.getElementById("war_scatter_plot");
    const isP30  = metric === "war_p30" || metric === "war_p30_exact";
    const plotRows = isP30 ? ranked.filter(r => r[metric] !== null && Number.isFinite(r[metric])) : ranked;

    if (plotRows.length === 0 || typeof Plotly === "undefined") {
      if (typeof Plotly !== "undefined") Plotly.purge(plotEl);
      plotEl.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:#777777;">No qualifying players match the active filters.</div>`;
    } else {
      const posPal = STATE.manifest.pos_palette || FALLBACK_MANIFEST.pos_palette;
      const posOrder = ["GK", "CB", "FB", "MF", "FWD"];
      const posNames = { GK: "Goalkeepers (GK)", CB: "Center Backs (CB)", FB: "Fullbacks (FB)", MF: "Midfielders (MF)", FWD: "Forwards (FWD)" };
      const metricTitleMap = {
        war: "Wins Above Replacement (WAR)",
        war_p30: "Paced WAR per 30 Matches (WAR/30)",
        war_exact: "Exact Bivariate DC Wins Above Replacement (WAR)",
        war_p30_exact: "Exact DC Paced WAR per 30 Matches (WAR/30)"
      };

      const traces = [];
      for (let pi = 0; pi < posOrder.length; pi++) {
        const pg = posOrder[pi];
        const grp = plotRows.filter(r => r.pos === pg);
        if (grp.length === 0) continue;
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter",
          mode: "markers",
          name: pg,
          legendgroup: pg,
          x: grp.map(r => r.mins),
          y: grp.map(r => r[metric]),
          customdata: grp.map(r => [
            r.name,
            r.team,
            r.role,
            r.war !== null ? r.war.toFixed(2) : "N/A",
            r.war_p30 !== null ? r.war_p30.toFixed(2) : "N/A (<450m)",
            r.net_xg_p90.toFixed(3),
            posNames[pg] || pg
          ]),
          marker: {
            color: posPal[pg] || "#00747A",
            size: 9,
            opacity: 0.78,
            line: { color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.65)", width: 0.8 }
          },
          hovertemplate:
            "<b>%{customdata[0]}</b><br>" +
            "%{customdata[1]} \u2022 %{customdata[2]} (%{customdata[6]})<br>" +
            "Minutes: %{x:,.0f}<br>" +
            "Metric Value: <b>%{y:.2f}</b><br>" +
            "Net xG/90: %{customdata[5]} | WAR: %{customdata[3]} | WAR/30: %{customdata[4]}" +
            "<extra></extra>"
        });
      }

      // Top-8 leader text labels matching app.R L1626-1641
      const top8 = [...plotRows].sort((a, b) => b[metric] - a[metric]).slice(0, 8);
      if (top8.length > 0) {
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter",
          mode: "text",
          x: top8.map(r => r.mins),
          y: top8.map(r => r[metric]),
          text: top8.map(r => r.name),
          textposition: "top center",
          textfont: { family: "Assistant, sans-serif", size: 11.5, color: "#111111" },
          showlegend: false,
          hoverinfo: "skip"
        });
      }

      const layout = {
        margin: { t: 18, r: 24, b: 68, l: 64 },
        xaxis: {
          title: { text: "<b>Total Minutes Played</b>", font: { family: "Assistant, sans-serif", size: 13, color: "#333333" } },
          tickformat: ",d",
          gridcolor: "#EEF0F2",
          zeroline: false
        },
        yaxis: {
          title: { text: `<b>${metricTitleMap[metric] || "WAR"}</b>`, font: { family: "Assistant, sans-serif", size: 13, color: "#333333" } },
          gridcolor: "#EEF0F2",
          zeroline: false
        },
        shapes: [{
          type: "line",
          xref: "paper",
          x0: 0, x1: 1,
          y0: 0, y1: 0,
          line: { color: "#888888", dash: "dash", width: 1.5 }
        }],
        legend: {
          orientation: "h",
          x: 0.5, xanchor: "center",
          y: -0.22, yanchor: "top",
          font: { family: "Assistant, sans-serif", size: 12 }
        },
        hovermode: "closest",
        font: { family: "Assistant, sans-serif" },
        plot_bgcolor: "#FFFFFF",
        paper_bgcolor: "#FFFFFF"
      };

      Plotly.react(plotEl, traces, layout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true });
    }

    renderWarTable(displayed, league.meta);
  }

  function renderWarTable(rows, meta) {
    const hasComp  = Boolean(meta && meta.has_comp);
    const hasExact = Boolean(meta && meta.has_war_exact);
    const posPal   = STATE.manifest.pos_palette || FALLBACK_MANIFEST.pos_palette;

    const cols = [
      { key: "rank",       label: "Rank",        num: true,  fmt: r => r.rank },
      { key: "name",       label: "Player",      num: false, fmt: r => `<strong>${escapeHtml(r.name)}</strong>` },
      { key: "team",       label: "Team",        num: false, fmt: r => escapeHtml(r.team) },
      ...(hasComp ? [{ key: "comp", label: "Competition", num: false, fmt: r => escapeHtml(r.comp || "") }] : []),
      { key: "pos",        label: "Pos Group",   num: false, fmt: r => `<span class="rapm-pos-badge" style="background:${posPal[r.pos] || "#555555"};">${escapeHtml(r.pos)}</span>` },
      { key: "role",       label: "Role",        num: false, fmt: r => escapeHtml(r.role) },
      { key: "mins",       label: "Minutes",     num: true,  fmt: r => Math.round(r.mins).toLocaleString("en-US") },
      { key: "net_xg_p90", label: "Net xG/90",   num: true,  fmt: r => `<span class="${r.net_xg_p90 >= 0 ? "rapm-val-pos" : "rapm-val-neg"}">${formatSigned(r.net_xg_p90, 3)}</span>` },
      { key: "gaa",        label: "GAA",         num: true,  fmt: r => r.gaa.toFixed(2) },
      { key: "gar",        label: "GAR",         num: true,  fmt: r => r.gar.toFixed(2) },
      { key: "par",        label: "PAR",         num: true,  fmt: r => r.par.toFixed(1) },
      { key: "war",        label: "WAR",         num: true,  fmt: r => r.war !== null ? r.war.toFixed(2) : "—" },
      ...(hasExact ? [{ key: "war_exact", label: "WAR (Exact)", num: true, fmt: r => r.war_exact !== null ? r.war_exact.toFixed(2) : "—" }] : []),
      { key: "war_p30",    label: "WAR/30",      num: true,  fmt: r => r.war_p30 !== null ? r.war_p30.toFixed(2) : "—" }
    ];

    const thead = document.getElementById("war_table_head");
    const trHead = document.createElement("tr");
    cols.forEach(col => {
      const th = document.createElement("th");
      th.className = "sortable" + (col.num ? " num" : "");
      const arrow = STATE.warSortCol === col.key ? (STATE.warSortDir === "asc" ? " \u25B2" : " \u25BC") : "";
      th.textContent = col.label + arrow;
      th.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (STATE.warSortCol === col.key) {
          STATE.warSortDir = STATE.warSortDir === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc";
        } else {
          STATE.warSortCol = col.key;
          STATE.warSortDir = col.num && col.key !== "rank" ? "desc" : "asc";
        }
        STATE.warPage = 1;
        renderTab2();
      });
      trHead.appendChild(th);
    });
    thead.innerHTML = "";
    thead.appendChild(trHead);

    const pageLen = Number(document.getElementById("war_page_len").value) || 20;
    const total = rows.length;
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageLen));
    if (STATE.warPage > totalPages) STATE.warPage = totalPages;
    const startIdx = (STATE.warPage - 1) * pageLen;
    const endIdx   = Math.min(total, startIdx + pageLen);
    const slice = rows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

    const tbody = document.getElementById("war_table_body");
    if (slice.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="${cols.length}" style="text-align:center;color:#777777;padding:1.25rem;">No matching players found.</td></tr>`;
    } else {
      tbody.innerHTML = slice.map(r => `<tr>${cols.map(c => `<td${c.num ? ' class="num"' : ""}>${c.fmt(r)}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("");
    }

    document.getElementById("war_table_info").textContent = total === 0
      ? "Showing 0 to 0 of 0 entries"
      : `Showing ${startIdx + 1} to ${endIdx} of ${total.toLocaleString("en-US")} entries`;

    renderPager("war_table_pager", STATE.warPage, totalPages, (newPg) => {
      STATE.warPage = newPg;
      renderWarTable(STATE.warFilteredCache, meta);
    });
  }

  function renderPager(containerId, curPage, totalPages, onPageChange) {
    const pager = document.getElementById(containerId);
    pager.innerHTML = "";
    if (totalPages <= 1) return;

    const addBtn = (label, page, disabled, active) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.className = "rapm-page-btn" + (active ? " active" : "");
      btn.textContent = label;
      btn.disabled = disabled;
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => onPageChange(page));
      pager.appendChild(btn);
    };

    addBtn("Prev", Math.max(1, curPage - 1), curPage <= 1, false);
    const winStart = Math.max(1, curPage - 2);
    const winEnd   = Math.min(totalPages, curPage + 2);
    if (winStart > 1) addBtn("1", 1, false, curPage === 1);
    if (winStart > 2) {
      const dots = document.createElement("span");
      dots.textContent = "\u2026";
      dots.style.padding = "0 0.25rem";
      pager.appendChild(dots);
    }
    for (let p = winStart; p <= winEnd; p++) addBtn(String(p), p, false, p === curPage);
    if (winEnd < totalPages - 1) {
      const dots = document.createElement("span");
      dots.textContent = "\u2026";
      dots.style.padding = "0 0.25rem";
      pager.appendChild(dots);
    }
    if (winEnd < totalPages) addBtn(String(totalPages), totalPages, false, curPage === totalPages);
    addBtn("Next", Math.min(totalPages, curPage + 1), curPage >= totalPages, false);
  }

  function downloadWarCsv() {
    const league = getActiveLeague();
    if (!league || !STATE.warFilteredCache) return;
    const csv = generateWarCsv(STATE.warFilteredCache, league.meta);
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const dStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `war_leaderboard_${STATE.activeLeagueId}_${dStr}.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);
  }

  // --- TAB 3 RENDERING ---
  function renderTab3(resetPage = true) {
    const league = getActiveLeague();
    if (!league) return;
    const teamName  = document.getElementById("opt_team_select").value;
    const formation = document.getElementById("opt_formation_select").value;
    const metric    = document.getElementById("opt_metric_select").value;

    const errEl = document.getElementById("opt_error_msg");
    const sumEl = document.getElementById("opt_summary_bar");
    const lBody = document.getElementById("opt_lineup_body");
    const bBody = document.getElementById("opt_bench_body");

    if (!teamName) {
      errEl.classList.remove("visible");
      sumEl.style.display = "none";
      lBody.innerHTML = "";
      bBody.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    let roster = league.players.filter(p => p.team === teamName);
    const activeRoster = roster.filter(p => p.active);
    if (activeRoster.length >= 11) roster = activeRoster;

    if (roster.length < 11) {
      errEl.textContent = `Not enough players for ${teamName} (${roster.length}) to form a starting XI.`;
      errEl.classList.add("visible");
      sumEl.style.display = "none";
      lBody.innerHTML = "";
      bBody.innerHTML = "";
      document.getElementById("opt_bench_info").textContent = "";
      document.getElementById("opt_bench_pager").innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    errEl.classList.remove("visible");
    const res = solveBestXI(roster, league.players, formation, metric, STATE.manifest.formations);
    STATE.lastBestXi = res;
    if (!res) return;

    if (resetPage) STATE.benchPage = 1;

    const xiNet = res.lineup.reduce((acc, row) => acc + row.player.net, 0);
    const xiOff = res.lineup.reduce((acc, row) => acc + row.player.off, 0);
    const xiDef = res.lineup.reduce((acc, row) => acc + row.player.def, 0);
    sumEl.style.display = "flex";
    sumEl.innerHTML = `
      <span><strong>${escapeHtml(teamName)} (${escapeHtml(formation)})</strong></span>
      <span>Eligible Pool: <strong>${roster.length}</strong> players</span>
      <span>Combined Raw Net RAPM: <strong>${formatSigned(xiNet, 3)}</strong> (Off ${formatSigned(xiOff, 3)} / Def ${formatSigned(xiDef, 3)})</span>
    `;

    lBody.innerHTML = res.lineup.map(({ slot, player }) => `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>${escapeHtml(slot)}</strong></td>
        <td><strong>${escapeHtml(player.name)}</strong></td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(player.role)}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(player.sec_role)}</td>
        <td class="num">${Math.round(player.mins).toLocaleString("en-US")}</td>
        <td class="num"><span class="${player.net >= 0 ? "rapm-val-pos" : "rapm-val-neg"}">${player.net.toFixed(3)}</span></td>
        <td class="num">${player.off.toFixed(3)}</td>
        <td class="num">${player.def.toFixed(3)}</td>
      </tr>
    `).join("");

    renderBenchPage(res.bench);
  }

  function renderBenchPage(bench) {
    const bBody = document.getElementById("opt_bench_body");
    const pageLen = 8;
    const total = bench.length;
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageLen));
    if (STATE.benchPage > totalPages) STATE.benchPage = totalPages;
    const startIdx = (STATE.benchPage - 1) * pageLen;
    const endIdx   = Math.min(total, startIdx + pageLen);
    const slice = bench.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

    if (slice.length === 0) {
      bBody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;color:#777777;padding:1rem;">No additional squad depth available.</td></tr>`;
    } else {
      bBody.innerHTML = slice.map(p => `
        <tr>
          <td><strong>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</strong></td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(p.role)}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(p.sec_role)}</td>
          <td class="num">${Math.round(p.mins).toLocaleString("en-US")}</td>
          <td class="num"><span class="${p.net >= 0 ? "rapm-val-pos" : "rapm-val-neg"}">${p.net.toFixed(3)}</span></td>
        </tr>
      `).join("");
    }

    document.getElementById("opt_bench_info").textContent = total === 0
      ? ""
      : `Showing ${startIdx + 1} to ${endIdx} of ${total} bench players`;
    renderPager("opt_bench_pager", STATE.benchPage, totalPages, (pg) => {
      STATE.benchPage = pg;
      renderBenchPage(bench);
    });
  }

  // --- LEAGUE & ASSET LOADING ---
  function populateLeagueSelect() {
    const sel = document.getElementById("global_league_select");
    sel.innerHTML = "";
    (STATE.manifest.leagues || []).forEach(lg => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = lg.id;
      opt.textContent = lg.label;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    });
    sel.value = STATE.activeLeagueId;
  }

  function syncDropdownsForActiveLeague() {
    const league = getActiveLeague();
    if (!league) return;

    // Tab 1 Outfield Players sorted alphabetically
    const outfield = league.players
      .filter(p => p.role !== "Goalkeeper" && p.spatial_idx >= 0)
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    if (STATE.playerCombo) STATE.playerCombo.setPlayers(outfield);

    // Tab 2 Teams
    const warTeams = Array.from(new Set(league.warRows.map(w => w.team).filter(Boolean))).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    const warTeamSel = document.getElementById("war_team_filter");
    warTeamSel.innerHTML = `<option value="All Teams">All Teams</option>` +
      warTeams.map(t => `<option value="${escapeHtml(t)}">${escapeHtml(t)}</option>`).join("");
    warTeamSel.value = "All Teams";
    STATE.warPage = 1;
    STATE.warSortCol = null;
    STATE.warSortDir = "desc";

    // Tab 3 Teams
    const teams = Array.from(new Set(league.players.map(p => p.team).filter(Boolean))).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    const optTeamSel = document.getElementById("opt_team_select");
    optTeamSel.innerHTML = teams.map(t => `<option value="${escapeHtml(t)}">${escapeHtml(t)}</option>`).join("");
    if (teams.length > 0) optTeamSel.value = teams[0];
    STATE.benchPage = 1;
  }

  async function ensureLeagueLoaded(leagueId) {
    if (STATE.leagueCache.has(leagueId)) return STATE.leagueCache.get(leagueId);
    const meta = (STATE.manifest.leagues || []).find(l => l.id === leagueId);
    if (!meta) throw new Error(`Unknown league '${leagueId}'.`);
    const resp = await fetch(meta.url);
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Failed loading ${meta.label} (${resp.status} ${resp.statusText}).`);
    const rawJson = await resp.json();
    const hydrated = hydrateLeagueData(rawJson);
    STATE.leagueCache.set(leagueId, hydrated);
    return hydrated;
  }

  async function onLeagueChange(leagueId) {
    STATE.activeLeagueId = leagueId;
    const lgMeta = getActiveLeagueMeta();
    setStatus("loading", `Loading ${lgMeta ? lgMeta.short : leagueId}...`);
    showError("");
    try {
      await ensureLeagueLoaded(leagueId);
      syncDropdownsForActiveLeague();
      await renderActiveTab();
      const lg = getActiveLeague();
      setStatus("ready", `${lgMeta ? lgMeta.short : leagueId} Ready (${lg ? lg.players.length : 0} players)`);
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus("error", "Asset load pending");
      showError(`Unable to load static RAPM assets for ${lgMeta ? lgMeta.label : leagueId} (${err.message}). If building locally, run Rscript export_rapm_web_assets.R inside rapm-backend to generate quarto_site/data/rapm/.`);
    }
  }

  async function renderActiveTab() {
    if (STATE.activeTab === "profile") {
      await renderTab1();
    } else if (STATE.activeTab === "war") {
      renderTab2();
      const plotEl = document.getElementById("war_scatter_plot");
      if (plotEl && typeof Plotly !== "undefined") Plotly.Plots.resize(plotEl);
    } else if (STATE.activeTab === "bestxi") {
      renderTab3();
    }
  }

  function switchTab(tab) {
    STATE.activeTab = tab;
    const panels = ["profile", "war", "bestxi"];
    panels.forEach(p => {
      document.getElementById(`rapm-panel-${p}`).style.display = (p === tab) ? "grid" : "none";
      const btn = document.getElementById(`rapm-tab-btn-${p}`);
      btn.classList.toggle("active", p === tab);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-selected", p === tab ? "true" : "false");
    });
    renderActiveTab();
  }

  async function bootstrap() {
    STATE.playerCombo = initPlayerCombobox(() => renderTab1());

    // Wire Tab buttons
    document.querySelectorAll(".rapm-tab-btn").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => switchTab(btn.dataset.tab));
    });

    // Wire League selector
    const lgSelect = document.getElementById("global_league_select");
    lgSelect.addEventListener("change", () => onLeagueChange(lgSelect.value));

    // Wire Tab 1 controls
    document.querySelectorAll('input[name="prof_view_mode"]').forEach(r => {
      r.addEventListener("change", () => renderTab1());
    });
    document.getElementById("download_full_map").addEventListener("click", () => downloadPngMap("full"));
    document.getElementById("download_offense_map").addEventListener("click", () => downloadPngMap("offense"));
    document.getElementById("download_defense_map").addEventListener("click", () => downloadPngMap("defense"));

    // Wire Tab 2 controls
    document.querySelectorAll('input[name="war_plot_metric"]').forEach(r => {
      r.addEventListener("change", () => { STATE.warPage = 1; renderTab2(); });
    });
    ["war_pos_filter", "war_team_filter", "war_page_len"].forEach(id => {
      document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("change", () => { STATE.warPage = 1; renderTab2(); });
    });
    document.getElementById("war_min_minutes").addEventListener("input", () => { STATE.warPage = 1; renderTab2(); });
    document.getElementById("war_table_search").addEventListener("input", () => { STATE.warPage = 1; renderTab2(); });
    document.getElementById("download_war_csv").addEventListener("click", downloadWarCsv);

    // Wire Tab 3 controls
    ["opt_team_select", "opt_formation_select", "opt_metric_select"].forEach(id => {
      document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("change", () => renderTab3(true));
    });
    document.getElementById("opt_run_btn").addEventListener("click", () => renderTab3(true));

    // Fetch live manifest (fallback to inline defaults if unavailable)
    setStatus("loading", "Loading spatial basis & NWSL...");
    try {
      const mResp = await fetch(`data/rapm/manifest.json?ts=${Date.now()}`, { cache: "no-store" });
      if (mResp.ok) {
        const liveManifest = await mResp.json();
        if (liveManifest && Array.isArray(liveManifest.leagues) && liveManifest.leagues.length > 0) {
          STATE.manifest = liveManifest;
          if (Array.isArray(liveManifest.mccurdy_palette)) {
            STATE.palette19 = buildColorPalette(liveManifest.mccurdy_palette, 19);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_ignored) {
      // Retain FALLBACK_MANIFEST cleanly
    }

    populateLeagueSelect();

    try {
      const tpsUrl = STATE.manifest.tps_player_url || "data/rapm/tps_player.bin";
      const [tpsResp] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(tpsUrl).then(r => {
          if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`TPS basis fetch failed (${r.status}).`);
          return r.arrayBuffer();
        }),
        ensureLeagueLoaded(STATE.activeLeagueId)
      ]);
      STATE.tps = parseWtpsBinary(tpsResp);
      syncDropdownsForActiveLeague();
      await renderActiveTab();
      const lgMeta = getActiveLeagueMeta();
      const lg = getActiveLeague();
      setStatus("ready", `${lgMeta ? lgMeta.short : "NWSL"} Ready (${lg ? lg.players.length : 0} players)`);
      showError("");
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus("error", "Web assets not found");
      showError(`Static RAPM data assets could not be loaded (${err.message}). Run Rscript export_rapm_web_assets.R from rapm-backend to populate quarto_site/data/rapm/ before rendering.`);
    }
  }

  bootstrap();
})();
</script>
